result.subject: Quick check on FY27 hiring plan circulation
result.body:
Hi Head of People,

I hope you’re well. I wanted to touch base on the revised FY27 hiring plan that needs to be circulated to the Board. We’re 20 days past the original due date and I’d like to provide the CEO with an update before the next Board meeting on Nov 26. Could you share a status update and, if needed, a realistic new delivery date? Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to help unblock this.

Thanks,
Business Operations
